title: Contribution Title Search Fee — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Lien Release Charges
content:
Contribution title search fee — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction lien release charges

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the contribution title search fee forms part of the seller closing contribution.

**Rule.** The contribution title search fee is USD 95.00 when the loan's closing date is at least 120 whole calendar months before the remittance date, and USD 65.00 when it is at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole calendar months before it; a loan closed more recently takes no higher fee under this schedule, and a loan with no closing date counts 0 months. The closing date is read from the loan record: the HECM's under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product, or the Summit loan's under the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage product.

| Whole calendar months from the closing date to the remittance date | Contribution title search fee |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | USD 95.00 |
| 60 to 119 | USD 65.00 |
| fewer than 60, or no closing date | no higher fee under this schedule |

**Boundary.** A whole calendar month is complete when the same day of a later month is reached: a loan closed on 10 May counts 60 months on 10 May five years later, and 59 on 9 May.
